meta_description: Derek Gethins is a painter and decorator in Leicester. Interior and exterior painting, wallpapering, and decorating. Free quotes, local and reliable.
hero_subhead: Interior and exterior painting done right, first time. Free quote within 24 hours.
services_heading: Complete Painting & Decorating Services Across Leicester
services_subhead: From interior redecoration to exterior paint work, we handle every job with care and attention to detail.

services.title: Interior Painting & Decorating
services.desc: Walls, ceilings, woodwork, and feature finishes for living rooms, kitchens, bedrooms, and bathrooms. We prepare surfaces properly and use quality paints for a finish that lasts.

services.title: Exterior Painting
services.desc: Fascias, soffits, doors, and window frames exposed to Leicester weather. Weather-resistant coatings protect your home and boost kerb appeal.

services.title: Wallpapering
services.desc: Pattern matching, feature walls, and delicate removals. We hang wallpaper straight and neat, with no bubbles or peeling corners.

services.title: Woodwork & Joinery
services.desc: Doors, skirting, architrave, and built-in cupboards sanded, primed, and finished to a professional standard.

services.title: Textured Finishes & Artexing
services.desc: Polished plaster, Venetian effects, and textured coatings for that premium look. Ideal for feature walls and period properties.

services.title: Commercial & Retail Painting
services.desc: Shop fronts, offices, and commercial spaces painted to your brand colours. We work flexibly around trading hours.

about_pullquote: I paint homes the way I'd want mine painted—carefully, honestly, and on time.
about_para_1: Derek Gethins has been painting and decorating across Leicester for over 20 years. Starting as an apprentice, he built his reputation one satisfied customer at a time. Today, he's known locally for showing up when promised, doing the job right, and leaving no mess behind.
about_para_2: Homeowners and landlords trust Derek because he listens to what you want, gives straight advice, and sticks to his quote. He sources quality paints and materials, takes pride in preparation, and leaves your home looking fresh and well cared for. Many of his customers come back year after year.
reviews_heading: What Leicester Homeowners Say About Derek

reviews.text: Derek painted our whole house—inside and out—and the standard is excellent. He's tidy, professional, and actually listens to what you want. Finished on time too, which is rare. Would definitely have him back.
reviews.author: Martin T.

reviews.text: Had Derek decorate our lounge and hallway. He stripped the old wallpaper, prepared everything properly, and hung new paper with barely a crease. Very fair price and no pressure. Top bloke.
reviews.author: Rebecca K.

reviews.text: We were nervous about getting our Victorian terrace painted, but Derek knows old houses. Picked the right colours, took care with the woodwork, and the finish is beautiful. Highly recommend him.
reviews.author: James P.
